description: Stable lab contracts for federated engines and external peers. Process lifecycle is systemd-group; wire is signals-protocol.

license_boundary.core_peers: Gaius, Aegir, Atelier, and future in-family projects (e.g. synth, vigil) — shared engine family; protocol co-evolution center
license_boundary.external_peers: License-incompatible products (e.g. AGPL Metabase) — external by requirement; isolated engines; process+wire only
license_boundary.integration: Process boundary (systemd units + network) + signals-protocol gRPC; no static link or vendoring of AGPL into ASL2 binaries or core peer trees
license_boundary.architecture_note: Metabase is not a core Signals engine project; do not treat mbengine as Gaius-lineage

postgres.note: Do not bind peer devenv Postgres here

port_lattice_postgres.5432: system/apt (leave alone; Metabase app DB may use this)

server_reflection.purpose: External tooling (bare grpcurl) without local descriptors
